content: Add `import random` + v2-aware chunker (5000 hard, 2000-3000 soft, paragraph-preferring, sentence-only splits)
Rewrite tts_chunk_to_audio_sync to support seed + previous_request_ids, use with_raw_response, return (audio_bytes, request_id)
Update tts_chunk_with_retry to thread seed/previous_request_ids and return tuple
Update create_job: when model=multilingual_v2 use v2 chunker + generate/persist seed
Update process_tts_job: build request_ids list, pass seed+previous_request_ids, persist per-chunk request_id
Update resume_tts_job: rehydrate request_ids from completed chunk_requests, continue chain
Lint + restart backend + curl smoke test the stitching path
